feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Former Anthropic researcher outlines threat of AI going rogue
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Jacob Coxon, a former researcher at the AI company Anthropic who resigned in protest over the dangers of AI.

entry.title: How Gillian Anderson opened her mind to desires that go far beyond a person's sex life
entry.summary: Gillian Anderson is known for her work in X-Files and The Crown. But her role in Sex Education convinced her that she wanted to encourage women to talk about the fantasies they've kept secret.

entry.title: Two Juilliard students created a global art project in the wake of 9/11
entry.summary: Sing for Hope, which creates artist-decorated pianos and puts them in public spaces for everyone to enjoy, started after two Juilliard students thought about giving up performing in the wake of 9/11.

entry.title: This summer was hot. August shattered global heat records
entry.summary: Scientists say that August was the hottest month ever recorded globally. In the U.S., summer temperatures also shattered heat records.

entry.title: Amid war and sanctions, unemployment worsens in Iran
entry.summary: As the U.S. war with Iran drags on, Iranians face increasing layoffs and a rising unemployment rate.

entry.title: After court flurry, Missouri officials set aside GOP redistricting
entry.summary: After a flurry of court maneuvers, the Republican redistricting of U.S. House seats in Missouri is blocked. It's a win for Democrats fighting to win control of the House — but maybe not over yet.

entry.title: 'The gloves were off.' What America did to stay safe after 9/11
entry.summary: Did America sacrifice too much to stay safe after the 9/11 terror attacks?

entry.title: 'Junk fees' make buying a home even more expensive
entry.summary: Real estate agents are sounding the alarm on a growing fee they say home buyers should not pay.

entry.title: Here's what to know about the NFL season
entry.summary: The NFL regular season has kicked off. Among this year's changes, the league is rolling out a new three-strike policy for dangerous tackles.

entry.title: Anti-Muslim rhetoric is finding a growing foothold in GOP messaging ahead of November
entry.summary: A strain of anti-Muslim bigotry has become increasingly common in GOP politics, manifesting everywhere from a "Sharia-free America" caucus in Congress to rhetoric on the campaign trail.
